purpose: External source registry for candidate assets. Entries are not installed game resources.

promotion_requirements: license evidence captured with the package
static format, topology, material, skeleton and animation inspection
Source 2 compile and in-game client/server verification

sources.name: Cethiel's Dragon 3D
sources.use: Dragon character or summoned-creature candidate; inspect exact archive contents, rig, skeleton, animations, scale and textures before porting.

sources.name: Gobkit Free Animal Pack
sources.inventory: 10 rigged animated creatures; idle, attack, dead and walk timeline segments at 24 FPS.
sources.technical_notes: One master animation timeline per GLB. Split actions using the exact frame ranges in the manifest. Local +Z is forward, +Y is up, units are metres.

sources.name: Gobkit Free Minion Pack
sources.inventory: 8 rigged low-poly enemies; idle, attack and dead timeline segments at 24 FPS.
sources.technical_notes: One master animation timeline per GLB. Split actions using the exact frame ranges in the manifest.

sources.name: Kenney Particle Pack
sources.inventory: 80 particle, light-cookie and shader sprites; sample effects cover fire, smoke, magic, hearts, sparks and electricity.
sources.use: Texture source for custom Source 2 particles. This is not itself a VPCF particle effect.

sources.name: Kenney Smoke Particles
sources.inventory: 77 sprite files across five styles: black smoke, explosion, fart, flash and white puff.
sources.use: Texture source for smoke, impact and blast VPCFs. This is not a ready-made CS2 effect.

additional_research_candidates.name: Fantasy Creatures: 26 rigged and animated
additional_research_candidates.inventory: 26 creatures. The dragon has 14 clips including idle, locomotion, bite, claw, tail sweep, roar, fire breath, takeoff, fly, glide, land, hit and death. The hydra has three heads and nine clips.

additional_research_candidates.name: Fantasy Forge
additional_research_candidates.inventory: 144 models and 479 named animation clips; original GLB, two LOD tiers and Blender source files.

additional_research_candidates.name: Kaino SFX Library
additional_research_candidates.inventory: 1397 sound effects across 21 categories, including creatures, fantasy/RPG, magic, spell, impacts, fire and whoosh.

additional_research_candidates.name: Grab3D Dragon catalogue
additional_research_candidates.risk: Some high-detail entries are very heavy or static; do not select for a live CS2 server without checking polygon budget and rigging.

additional_research_candidates.name: SupaVoxel humanoid animation tool
additional_research_candidates.inventory: Accepts an already-rigged humanoid GLB/FBX and offers 160 CC0 clips; exports animated GLB with one clip or a set.
additional_research_candidates.use: Retarget locomotion, attack, hit and death animation to existing humanoid player-agent rigs.

additional_research_candidates.name: KinemIQ free game animations
additional_research_candidates.license: 175 CC0 clips; an additional 170 clips require CC BY 4.0 and 115 require CC BY 3.0
additional_research_candidates.inventory: The complete browser library lists 460 clips on one humanoid skeleton; 175 from Quaternius are CC0, 170 require CC BY 4.0 and 115 require CC BY 3.0. The standalone downloadable CC0 pack currently advertised on the asset page contains 35 clips and is offered as 2.4 MB FBX and 2.1 MB GLB archives.
additional_research_candidates.technical_notes: Use only the 35-clip stand-alone CC0 pack for straightforward import. The larger 175-clip CC0 collection is advertised in the full browser library; do not assume it is identical to the 35-clip ZIP or that non-CC0 clips are included without attribution obligations.

additional_research_candidates.name: AutoSprite Free Game Assets
additional_research_candidates.inventory: 20 3D GLB models, 13 animated 2D character sheets and 50 2D prop/effect sheets.
additional_research_candidates.risk: The 2D sheets are useful for menus/icons but cannot replace a rigged 3D CS2 player agent.

additional_research_candidates.name: SpritePilot Sound Effects
additional_research_candidates.inventory: 78 WAV/OGG/MP3 sound effects covering impacts, combat, magic, creatures, UI and ambience.

additional_research_candidates.name: SpritePilot Pixel Art Game Assets
additional_research_candidates.inventory: 82 sprites and sheets; 7 general effects, 9 combat effects and 9 spell/projectile effects.
additional_research_candidates.technical_notes: 2D sheets, not ready-made CS2 VPCF resources.

additional_research_candidates.name: Free CC0 Monster Sprites
additional_research_candidates.inventory: Slime, mushroom, goblin and stone golem sprite sheets with idle/walk/attack/hurt/death animation sets.
